title: Toronto man identified as Lindsay shooting victim by SIU
article: A shooting victim, initially believed to be from Durham Region, has been identified as a Toronto man.

According to a Special Investigations Unit news release, 21-year-old Corey Aaron Armstrong of Morningside Avenue in Toronto was killed during a June 22 incident in Lindsay. A Peterborough police constable was also shot multiple times and taken to hospital, and is expected to recover.

The incident saw five people, including a Bowmanville woman, arrested during the execution of a search warrant on Georgian Street in Lindsay. Police say all but one of the people arrested were released unconditionally pending further investigation. Jennifer Nicholson, 39, of Bowmanville, faces one charge of breach of recognizance and was scheduled to appear in a Lindsay court June 23.
The Special Investigation Unit is continuing its investigation into the death.
